name: Ox's workbench
text: Abel Brennan's workbench. Every spanner hangs inside its own painted outline, and a coffee tin does duty as a pencil cup. A tidy man, or a careful one.

name: Note in the toolbox
text:
Ox,
Borrowed your 9/16 spanner for the Trimotor. Left a dime for your trouble. Don't tell the Old Man.
— B.

name: Locker 3
text: Locker 3: a pair of oil-black overalls, a tin of boot blacking, and a photograph of a racing pigeon pinned up like a sweetheart.

name: Small brass key
text: A small brass key with a paper tag reading PARTS. It was lying on top of a crate in the south-east corner, as if someone had set it down and forgotten it.

name: Parts requisition
text:
PARTS REQUISITION, SABLE FLAT
Spark plugs, 12. Magneto points, 2. Cotter pins, 1 box.
Approved: C. Pryce.

In the margin, in pencil: "He counts every pin."
